info.name: LegitApp Developer API
info.description: Calls the LegitApp Developer API directly. Import and select Sandbox first; enter your Sandbox developer secret locally. Production is a separate environment. Follow folders in order; read prerequisites before conditional operations. No local server is required. See postman/README.md.

exec: if (!['sandbox', 'production'].includes(target)) throw new Error('Select the matching Sandbox or Production environment first.');
if (!pm.environment.get('developer_secret')) throw new Error('Set developer_secret locally in the selected environment.');
if (placeholder && !/^[1-9][0-9]*$/.test(String(placeholder))) throw new Error('service_placeholder_id must be blank or a positive placeholder ID from the selected authentication set.');

item.name: 03 - Server API submission
item.description: Reset images_json to [] for a new case. Repeat the upload request for each required view, then submit once.

request.description: Select a local image in Body > form-data > file. Repeat for every required view. URLs accumulate in images_json. Clear service_placeholder_id between uploads unless intentionally binding to the same placeholder. Local example limit: 10 MB.

exec: if (pm.response.code !== 201) throw new Error('Expected 201; received ' + pm.response.code + '. Check the response body and this request prerequisites.');
pm.test("Upload returns an image URL", function () { if (!(typeof body.url === 'string' && /^https?:\/\//.test(body.url))) throw new Error("Upload returns an image URL"); });
if (!images.some(current => current.image_url === image.image_url && current.service_placeholder_id === image.service_placeholder_id)) images.push(image);

item.name: 04 - Web Submission
item.description: Choose one intent example. Open the returned authentication_url in a browser and complete the hosted photo submission. An intent alone is not a submitted authentication.

request.description: Creates an unrestricted hosted submission. Saves authentication_intent_id, authentication_url and the future authentication_id. language controls the hosted page. Open authentication_url manually; do not publish it.

exec: if (pm.response.code !== 201) throw new Error('Expected 201; received ' + pm.response.code + '. Check the response body and this request prerequisites.');

pm.test("authentication_intent_id is a string", function () { if (!(typeof body.authentication_intent_id === 'string' && body.authentication_intent_id.length > 0)) throw new Error("authentication_intent_id is a string"); });

pm.test("Intent returns a hosted submission URL", function () { if (!(typeof body.authentication_url === 'string' && /^https:\/\//.test(body.authentication_url))) throw new Error("Intent returns a hosted submission URL"); });
